en: The image shows a black-and-white illustrated postcard featuring German soldiers from World War I. The central part of the image has two soldiers toasting with drinks, framed by a wreath with a ribbon. To the left, a soldier with a rifle stands guard in front of a building with a tower, likely a guard post or barracks. On the right, a woman and children wave, possibly symbolizing family waiting at home. There is German text on the postcard.
